description_en: Queries virus files detected under the current Alibaba Cloud account and their disposition status with paging. Supports filtering by virus type, risk level, user terminal device, user, and discovery time
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下检出的病毒文件及其处置状态，支持按病毒类型、风险等级、用户终端设备、用户与发现时间筛选
name: ListVirusFileStatuses

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Filters by virus type. Duplicate values are not allowed. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by virus type is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按病毒类型过滤，不允许重复。不传则不按病毒类型过滤
parameters.name: virus_types

parameters.help_en: Filters by risk level. Duplicate values are not allowed. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by risk level is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按风险等级过滤，不允许重复。不传则不按风险等级过滤
parameters.name: risk_levels

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the virus scan task that detected the virus file. This parameter is used to filter detection results of a specified task. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListVirusScanTasks](~~ListVirusScanTasks~~): Lists virus scan tasks.
[CreateVirusScanTask](~~CreateVirusScanTask~~): Creates a virus scan task
parameters.help_zh:
检出该病毒文件的病毒扫描任务ID，用于筛选指定任务的检出结果。取值来源：
[ListVirusScanTasks](~~ListVirusScanTasks~~)：批量查询病毒扫描任务。
[CreateVirusScanTask](~~CreateVirusScanTask~~)：创建病毒扫描任务
parameters.name: scan_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The user ID. Exact match. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Lists user terminal devices.
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries user terminal device details
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID，精确匹配。长度不超过128个字符。取值来源：
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备。
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~)：查询用户终端设备详情
parameters.name: sase_user_id

parameters.help_en: The username. Fuzzy match is supported. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), asterisks (*), hyphens (-), at signs (@), spaces, middle dots (·), and parentheses
parameters.help_zh: 用户名，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及半角句点（.）、下划线（_）、星号（*）、连字符（-）、@、空格、中间点（·）、圆括号
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en:
The operating system type of the user terminal device. Valid values:
windows: Windows.
macOS: macOS
parameters.help_zh:
用户终端设备的操作系统类型。取值：
windows：Windows系统。
macOS：macOS系统
parameters.name: dev_type

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the user terminal device. Exact match. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. You can obtain the value from the following operation:
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Lists user terminal devices
parameters.help_zh:
用户终端设备的唯一标识，精确匹配。长度不超过64个字符。取值来源：
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备
parameters.name: dev_tag

parameters.help_en: The hostname of the user terminal device. Fuzzy match is supported. The value can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户终端设备的主机名，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符
parameters.name: hostname

parameters.help_en: The department name. Matches any level of the organizational structure to which the user belongs. Specify the department name itself without the full path of the organizational structure. The value can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), commas (,), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: 部门名称，匹配用户所属组织架构中的任一层级部门。填写部门名称本身，不需要填写组织架构的完整路径。支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及空格、半角句点（.）、逗号（,）、分号（;）、正斜杠（/）、@、连字符（-）、下划线（_）
parameters.name: department

parameters.help_en:
Filters by disposition status. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by disposition status is applied. Valid values:
Pending: Pending disposition.
Processed: Disposed
parameters.help_zh:
按处置状态过滤。不传则不按处置状态过滤。取值：
Pending：待处置。
Processed：已处置
parameters.name: file_process_status

parameters.help_en: Filters by disposition action. Duplicate values are not allowed. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by disposition action is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按处置动作过滤，不允许重复。不传则不按处置动作过滤
parameters.name: operations

parameters.help_en: The start time for filtering by virus file discovery time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter must be specified together with EndTime and must be earlier than EndTime
parameters.help_zh: 病毒文件发现时间的筛选起点，秒级Unix时间戳。必须与EndTime同时传入，且小于EndTime
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for filtering by virus file discovery time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter must be specified together with StartTime and must be later than StartTime
parameters.help_zh: 病毒文件发现时间的筛选终点，秒级Unix时间戳。必须与StartTime同时传入，且大于StartTime
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The MD5 value of the virus file. Fuzzy match is supported. The value can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 病毒文件的MD5值，支持模糊查询。长度不超过64个字符
parameters.name: file_md5

items.description_en: The virus file and its disposition status
items.description_zh: 病毒文件及其处置状态

ConsoleOperationTime.description_en: The time when the administrator initiated the disposition, in the format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (UTC+8). An empty string is returned when the disposition was not initiated by an administrator
ConsoleOperationTime.description_zh: 管理员发起处置的时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用UTC+8时区。未由管理员发起处置时返回空字符串

Department.description_en: The name of the department to which the user belongs. Multiple departments are separated by commas (,). The nearest department name in the organizational structure is returned, not the full path
Department.description_zh: 用户所属部门名称，多个部门用半角逗号（,）分隔。取组织架构中距离用户最近的一级部门名称，不返回完整路径

DevTag.description_en: The unique identifier of the user's endpoint device that detected this virus file
DevTag.description_zh: 检出该病毒文件的用户终端设备的唯一标识

DevType.description_en:
The operating system type of the user terminal device. Valid values:
windows: Windows.
macOS: macOS
DevType.description_zh:
用户终端设备的操作系统类型。取值：
windows：Windows系统。
macOS：macOS系统

DiscoveryTime.description_en: The time when the virus file was discovered, in the format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (UTC+8). A hyphen (-) is returned when no record exists
DiscoveryTime.description_zh: 病毒文件的发现时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用UTC+8时区。无记录时返回短横线（-）

FileMd5.description_en: The MD5 hash of the virus file

FilePath.description_en: The absolute path of the virus file on the user's endpoint device
FilePath.description_zh: 病毒文件在用户终端设备上的绝对路径

FileProcessStatus.description_en:
The disposition status. Valid values:
Pending: Pending disposition.
Processed: Disposed
FileProcessStatus.description_zh:
处置状态。取值：
Pending：待处置。
Processed：已处置

FileSize.description_en: The size of the virus file, in bytes
FileSize.description_zh: 病毒文件大小，单位为字节

Hostname.description_en: The hostname of the user's endpoint device
Hostname.description_zh: 用户终端设备的主机名

Operation.description_en:
The disposition action that has been performed. An empty string is returned when no disposition has been performed. Valid values:
AdminQuarantine: Quarantined by administrator.
AdminTrust: Trusted by administrator.
UserQuarantine: Quarantined by endpoint user.
UserTrust: Trusted by endpoint user.
AutoQuarantine: Automatically quarantined based on policy.
Fail: Disposition failed
Operation.description_zh:
已执行的处置动作。未处置时返回空字符串。取值：
AdminQuarantine：管理员隔离。
AdminTrust：管理员信任。
UserQuarantine：终端用户隔离。
UserTrust：终端用户信任。
AutoQuarantine：按策略自动隔离。
Fail：处置失败

OperationTime.description_en: The effective period of the disposition, in the format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (UTC+8). The later of the actual disposition time on the user's endpoint device and the time when the administrator initiated the disposition is used. A hyphen (-) is returned when no disposition has been performed
OperationTime.description_zh: 处置生效时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用UTC+8时区。取用户终端设备实际处置时间与管理员发起处置时间中较晚的一个。未处置时返回短横线（-）

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level. Valid values:
High: High risk.
Mid: Medium risk.
Low: Low risk
RiskLevel.description_zh:
风险等级。取值：
High：高危。
Mid：中危。
Low：低危

ScanTaskId.description_en: The ID of the virus scan task that detected this virus file. An empty string is returned when the file is detected by real-time protection
ScanTaskId.description_zh: 检出该病毒文件的病毒扫描任务ID。由实时防御检出时返回空字符串

TaskExecutionInfo.description_en: The execution result description of the disposition or scan, reported by the user's endpoint device. If a disposition record exists, the execution result of the disposition task is returned. Otherwise, the execution result of the scan task is returned
TaskExecutionInfo.description_zh: 处置或扫描的执行结果描述，由用户终端设备上报。存在处置记录时返回处置任务的执行结果，否则返回扫描任务的执行结果

VirusFileSource.description_en:
The detection source of the virus file. Valid values:
Task: Detected by a virus scan task.
Download: Detected by real-time protection during file download.
Process: Detected by real-time protection during process execution
VirusFileSource.description_zh:
病毒文件的检出来源。取值：
Task：由病毒扫描任务检出。
Download：由实时防御在文件下载时检出。
Process：由实时防御在进程运行时检出

VirusType.description_en:
The virus type. Valid values:
Backdoor: Backdoor program.
DDoS: DDoS Trojan.
Downloader: Downloader Trojan.
Engtest: DPI engine test program.
Hacktool: Hacking tool.
Trojan: Self-mutating Trojan.
Malbaseware: Contaminated base software.
MalScript: Malicious script.
Malware: Malicious program.
Miner: Mining programs.
Proxytool: Proxy tool.
RansomWare: Ransomware.
RiskWare: Risky software.
Rootkit: Kernel-hidden program.
Stealer: Credential-stealing tool.
Scanner: Scanner.
Suspicious: Suspicious program.
Virus: File-infecting virus.
WebShell: Web shell.
Worm: Worms.
BlackList: File that hit the blacklist.
Exp: Vulnerability exploits program.
Patcher: Cracking program.
Gametool: Private server tool.
AdWare: Adware.
Maldoc: Malicious document
VirusType.description_zh:
病毒类型。取值：
Backdoor：后门程序。
DDoS：DDoS木马。
Downloader：下载器木马。
Engtest：引擎测试程序。
Hacktool：黑客工具。
Trojan：自变异木马。
Malbaseware：被污染的基础软件。
MalScript：恶意脚本。
Malware：恶意程序。
Miner：挖矿程序。
Proxytool：代理工具。
RansomWare：勒索病毒。
RiskWare：风险软件。
Rootkit：内核隐藏程序。
Stealer：窃密工具。
Scanner：扫描器。
Suspicious：可疑程序。
Virus：感染型病毒。
WebShell：网站后门。
Worm：蠕虫病毒。
BlackList：命中黑名单的文件。
Exp：漏洞利用程序。
Patcher：破解程序。
Gametool：私服工具。
AdWare：广告程序。
Maldoc：恶意文档

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of virus files that match the query conditions
TotalNum.description_zh: 符合查询条件的病毒文件总数
